title: Citadels
components: 8 Character Cards (Assassin, Thief, Magician, King, Bishop, Merchant, Architect, Warlord)
66 District Cards (Noble, Religious, Trade, Military, Unique)
setup: Give the Crown token to the oldest player.
Shuffle the district deck and deal 4 cards face-down to each player.
Each player takes 2 gold coins from the supply bank.
Prepare the 8 Character cards and place 1 face-down (hidden) and specific face-up cards according to player count.
procedure: Round Phase 1 - Character Selection: The crowned player reviews the remaining Character cards, secretly chooses 1, and passes the rest clockwise until all players have chosen.
Round Phase 2 - Turn Calls (Ordered 1 through 8): The Crown player calls characters in numeric order (1: Assassin, 2: Thief, 3: Magician, 4: King, 5: Bishop, 6: Merchant, 7: Architect, 8: Warlord).
Taking Your Turn: When your character number is called, reveal your card and perform the following:
Step A (Gather Resources): Either take 2 gold coins from the bank OR draw 2 district cards, keep 1, and discard the other.
Step B (Build Districts): Spend gold equal to the cost printed on a district card to place it face-up in your city (maximum 1 district build per turn, unless Architect).
Step C (Special Ability): Use your character's unique role power at any legal point during your turn.
endGame: Trigger: The game round ends after any player builds their 7th district (or 8th in classic edition). Complete the round so all 8 characters act.
Base Score: Points equal to the total gold cost of all districts in your city.
Color Bonus: +3 points if your city contains at least 1 district of all 5 colors (Yellow, Blue, Green, Red, Purple).
First to Finish Bonus: +4 points for the first player who built their 7th/8th district.
Other Finishers: +2 points for every other player who also reached 7+ districts this round.
Unique Districts: Add any bonus victory points granted by purple unique buildings.
⚖️ Tie-Breaker: Compare total score from printed district costs only; if still tied, player with most gold coins wins.
notes: Duplicate Buildings: You may never build two identical district cards in the same city.
The Bishop: Your districts cannot be destroyed by the Warlord, unless the Bishop was murdered by the Assassin.
The Crown: Choosing the King immediately claims the Crown token for the next round's draft, even if killed by the Assassin.
